verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line saying Bugbot Teams includes "analytics and reporting" (docs-28). Nothing describes what those analytics show, such as findings dashboards, acceptance or resolution rates per team, or review-coverage metrics across the org. The 80% resolution-rate figure in docs-35 is a vendor-wide blog statistic, not a customer-facing dashboard. Missing for 10: documented dashboard of findings, per-org acceptance/resolution-rate metrics, review-coverage reporting across repos, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the analytics feature.
